name: io.github.MRVDH/picnic-mcp
title: Picnic
description: Search products, fill the cart and pick a delivery slot at the online supermarket Picnic

environmentVariables.name: PICNIC_AUTH_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The auth key of the Picnic account. Get one with `npx picnic-mcp login`.

environmentVariables.name: PICNIC_COUNTRY_CODE
environmentVariables.description: The country of the account: NL, DE or FR.

environmentVariables.name: PICNIC_MCP_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: The tool groups to turn on, comma-separated, from cart, slots, product, discover, deliveries, recipes.
